name: What are the most popular flooring options for homes in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular flooring options for homes in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For Bay Area homes, popular flooring options include engineered hardwood, known for its durability and resistance to humidity fluctuations, and luxury vinyl plank (LVP), favored for its waterproof qualities and versatility. Tile, especially porcelain, is also common in kitchens and bathrooms due to its resilience and ease of maintenance. Carpet remains an option for bedrooms, offering comfort and sound insulation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engineered hardwood, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and tile are popular for Bay Area homes due to durability, water resistance, and aesthetic appeal.
